contents: D13-D16/{oracle,ref,trap-*,valid-*}, gen/, support/{billing,clinic}, meta.json, basis.json, validation/
verify: openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -pass file:KEY -in p3d-sealed.tar.gz.enc | sha256sum  # equals plaintextTarGzSha256
store: p3d (discovery: D13-D16 oracles, references, traps, valid alternatives, generators, support projects, meta.json, basis.json, validation/)
key: kept outside every repository until Stage 1 is scored; then published as p3d-sealed.key
